definitions.explanation: Describes a tool, machine, facility, or material that can serve many different uses. Primarily attaches to a noun as a modifier either directly ({多用途|たようと}{機|き} 'multi-purpose machine') or with の ({多用途|たようと}の{布|ぬの} 'versatile cloth'). Common in product descriptions, marketing copy, defense news, and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {多用途|たようと}⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多用途|たようと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This cloth can be used for many purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多用途|たようと}⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配備|はいび}→配備：25292_haibi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new-model multi-purpose helicopter has been deployed.

examples.japanese: {多用途|たようと}⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Designed as a multi-purpose hall, this building is used for both conferences and concerts.

notes:
Compound of {多|た} ('many') and ⟦{用途|ようと}→用途：04089_youto⟧ ('use; application'). The prefix {多|た}- forms many similar words: ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧ ('multifunction'), ⟦{多目的|たもくてき}→多目的：18132_tamokuteki⟧ ('multipurpose'), {多言語|たげんご} ('multilingual').

USAGE:
- Most often used as a prefix in compound nouns without a particle: {多用途|たようと}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧, {多用途|たようと}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧, {多用途|たようと}⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧, {多用途|たようと}⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧.
- As a predicate with a copula: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多用途|たようと}だ ('This tool is versatile').
- Adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {多用途|たようと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ / ⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ ('can be used for many purposes').
- In informal speech, the near-synonym ⟦{多目的|たもくてき}→多目的：18132_tamokuteki⟧ is more common; {多用途|たようと} has a more technical, product-spec feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多用途|たようと}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: multi-purpose machine/aircraft
- {多用途|たようと}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: multi-purpose vehicle
- {多用途|たようと}⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧: multi-purpose knife
- {多用途|たようと}⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧: multi-purpose helicopter
- {多用途|たようと}⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧: multi-purpose hall
- {多用途|たようと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to be usable for many purposes
- {多用途|たようと}⟦{護衛|ごえい}{艦|かん}→護衛艦：18332_goeikan⟧: multi-purpose escort ship (defense term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多目的|たもくてき}→多目的：18132_tamokuteki⟧: multipurpose — the most common near-synonym, especially for facilities (⟦{多目的|たもくてき}→多目的：18132_tamokuteki⟧⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧, ⟦{多目的|たもくてき}トイレ→多目的トイレ：07140_tamokutekitoire⟧).
- ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧: multifunctional — stresses multiple built-in functions, esp. of electronic/digital products.
- ⟦{万能|ばんのう}→万能：08818_bannou⟧: all-purpose; omnipotent — stronger claim; suggests it works for everything.
- ⟦{汎用|はんよう}→汎用：07653_hanyou⟧: general-purpose — often used in technical/industrial contexts (⟦{汎用|はんよう}→汎用：07653_hanyou⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ 'general-purpose machine').
